status: Windows x64 fix release: no visible engine console; Preserve existing folder structure accepts real TV layouts. Mac stays at 0.11.0, Android/Android TV at 0.11.1, Linux at 0.11.2.

checks.unitTests: 19 Windows baseline unit tests pass (connection, tunnel, preserved structure, planes, windows); typecheck and production build pass.
checks.engineConsole: On a physical Windows 11 PC with Windows Terminal as the default terminal, the media engine runs in a headless pseudoconsole: no visible window, output relayed, and a graceful stop logs Jellyfin database shutdown and exits 0.
checks.preservedStructure: The preserved-structure TV classifier accepted the developer's real mixed library layout that 0.11.3 rejected, choosing engine roots that already index 2,083 of 2,084 files.
checks.installedUpgrade: In-place silent upgrade from 0.11.3 preserved library, tunnel and public address; the server reported 0.11.4 locally and through its public HTTPS address.

limitations: Unsigned installer; SmartScreen may show an unknown publisher. Verify the SHA-256 before installing.
The full installed-application suite (windows-e2e) runs on disposable CI runners and was not rerun for this build.
Saving a preserved TV library end to end in Administration was not driven by automation; the classifier was verified on the real folders and in unit tests.

artifacts.role: Media server host: Lumio Stream server, Media Center and Administration
artifacts.intendedFor: Windows 10 and 11 x64, per-user install without elevation; upgrades 0.11.x in place
